name: St. Maurice
bio:
Maurice was the commander of the Theban Legion, a unit of Christian soldiers from Egypt serving in the Roman army. Around 287 the emperor Maximian ordered the legion to offer sacrifice to the gods before a campaign and to persecute local Christians.

Maurice and his men refused, declaring that they would obey the emperor in all lawful things but could not deny their faith. When the legion persisted in its refusal, Maximian ordered the soldiers decimated, and finally the entire legion was executed at Agaunum, in present-day Switzerland.

Maurice and his companions were venerated from the earliest centuries, and the abbey of Saint-Maurice d'Agaune became a great pilgrimage center. He is the patron of soldiers, infantrymen, and swordsmiths, and is honored as a model of fidelity to conscience.

prayer.text: St. Maurice, who with your Theban Legion chose death rather than deny Christ, pray for soldiers and for all who must obey authority, that they may obey God first. Amen.
